title: Crypto Prop Firm Registry and Verified Payouts — Roya Trading (snapshot 2026-09-25)
description:
Dated, machine-readable registry of crypto / on-chain proprietary trading firms maintained by Roya Trading: 7 scored firms (public Trust Score grid, last reviewed 2026-09-10), 8 entities tracked without a score, 10 DNS/HTTP status records (last verified 2026-09-25), an append-only changelog, and a headline counter (1 of 10 tracked firms gone dark since 2026-06, as of 2026-09-25).

Companion file: 54 prop-firm payouts received on Roya Trading's own accounts and reconciled on a public blockchain to the cent (48 Propr.xyz on Ethereum, 6 Hypernova on Arbitrum; read 2026-09-19), each with its transaction hash.

Every figure carries its read date. The files are regenerated at every deploy of roya-trading.com; this record is a dated snapshot. Detection rules: https://roya-trading.com/prop-firm-graveyard/methodology/ — Scoring grid: https://roya-trading.com/how-we-test-prop-firms/ — Affiliate disclosure: https://roya-trading.com/about/
notes: Snapshot fetched 2026-09-25T12:12:43Z (see data/READ_AT.txt). No affiliate links, no private wallet addresses: firm identifiers are the firms' own published contract/payout addresses. Roya Trading receives an affiliate commission from Propr.xyz, Hypernova and Carrot Funding on sign-ups through its site links; scores and statuses are not for sale.
